references.text: Joshua conquered Debir during the conquest of southern Canaan, demonstrating an earlier military campaign against this city
Parallel account of the attack on Debir, formerly called Kiriath-sepher, with identical wording and context
Debir is mentioned as one of the cities given to the tribe of Judah as an inheritance
Joshua destroyed the Anakites from Debir during his military campaigns
Debir was later given to the Levites as one of the priestly cities
